grounding.from: Trophy counts: Messi has eight Ballons d'Or, compared to Ronaldo's five
Tom Brady is still widely treated as the NFL GOAT
He has 7 Super Bowl wins (7-3 all-time)

value.answer: Depends which football you mean. Soccer: Messi. He's the pick for most people, and he has eight Ballons d'Or to Ronaldo's five. NFL: Tom Brady, with 7 Super Bowl wins. Mahomes is the one catching up, at 3-2 in Super Bowls so far.
